name: Wheeled Dual-arm Humanoid Robot
summary: Reconova’s Wheeled Dual-arm Humanoid Robot is designed to transfer irregular baggage such as backpacks and handbags. It combines a mobile base, an articulated upper body and two grippers with visual perception and coordinated manipulation. Reconova describes recognition, grasping, transport and placement as the intended workflow, complementing its Xiaoyi robot for regular suitcases. The platform was exhibited in 2026; verified commercial delivery status is unavailable.
